operations.name: validate_identity
operations.purpose: Resolve an active UserProfile by user_id and exact external_subject inside an active organization membership
operations.authorization: authenticated tenant context; organization comes from auth context

operations.name: link_identity
operations.purpose: Link an opaque vertical person reference to an existing Core identity

operations.name: unlink_identity
operations.purpose: Remove an identity link without changing membership

invariants: Existing CoreApi v0.1.0 operations and response version remain compatible.
Resolution requires exact user_id plus external_subject and an active organization, user, and membership.
The body cannot select actor or tenant; both come from the authenticated host context.
Link and unlink never create, activate, deactivate, or alter memberships.
A person has at most one active identity link per organization; same-target link is idempotent and conflicting target returns 409.
Cross-organization requests are rejected without revealing target existence.
Resolution, link, and unlink emit Core audit events with sanitized metadata.
Core treats person_id as opaque and never resolves identity by email, phone, or document.
